note: Post-hoc publication annotations for frozen cycle-07 verdict payloads. The verdict.json files are unaltered gate-runner outputs (apart from the disclosed absolute->repo-relative path scrub); the runner version that produced them has no vacuity field, so engagement-based qualifications are recorded here instead of editing frozen payloads. Source of engagement numbers: ../engagement.json (instrumented, per-seed).

T4-P0.basis: engagement.json T4 pooled: designated_true_enemy_opportunities=10, late_opportunities (turn>=30)=0, flips_applied=0. Verdict pass=true with zero treatment engagement; must be reported as PASS (vacuous), never bare PASS.

T4-P1.basis: Same engagement basis as T4-P0 (P1 == P0 on this matrix: no hearsay discoveries in any journal).

T4-P2.basis: No P2 commit-policy scorer column (unmeasured by construction) AND zero T4 engagement as above.

T1-P2.basis: G1 is scorer-side authentication segregation (forged_vote_entries), computed before any commit/fusion policy applies; the gate runner marks it applicable under every policy including P2. P2-unmeasured applies to commit/fusion gates only.
